Every third Combatant Shield broken with a <strand Strand /> or <stasis Stasis /> Weapon triggers an effect based on the Weapon's element:
• <strand Strand /> Weapons <strand Suspend /> the target
• <stasis Stasis /> Weapons <stasis Freeze /> the target

source.text:
For every THIRD Combatant Shield broken with a Strand or Stasis Weapon:

Strand inflicts Suspend.
Stasis inflicts Freeze.
